abstract: Biopsy of contralateral testis of 20 patients with an unilateral testicular tumor was carried out to evaluate the morphological changes of the contralateral testis caused by the tumor. Serum beta-chorionic gonadotropin (beta-hCG), follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH), luteinizing hormone (LH) and alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) levels before orchiectomy were examined as a function influencing morphological changes of the contralateral testis. Typical carcinoma in situ was found in a case of ipsilateral testis. The presence of a few atypical germ cells, however, was the only finding of the contralateral testis of three patients. Five of 20 patients revealed hypospermatogenesis in the contralateral intact testis. Most of the other patients also showed sloughing of germinal epithelium suggesting disorder of spermatogenesis. Johnsen's mean score count and tubular wall thickening were related to neither clinical stages, ESR, serum beta-hCG, AFP, LH nor FSH levels. Tubular wall thickening was observed in 8 of 10 patients with a tumor weighting over 150 g, but was found in only 1 of 10 patients with a lighter tumor (p less than 0.01).
abstract_ja: 片側性精巣腫瘍患者20例の対側精巣の生検を行い、腫瘍が引き起こす対側精巣の形態学的変化を評価した。術前の血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(β-hCG)、卵胞刺激ホルモン(FSH)、黄体形成ホルモン(LH)、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の値を、対側精巣の形態変化に影響する因子として検討した。同側精巣に典型的な上皮内癌が1例で認められた。3例では対側精巣に異型胚細胞が少数認められたのみであった。患者20例中5例で対側の非罹患精巣に精子形成低下がみられた。ほかの多くの患者でも、精上皮の脱落が認められ、精子形成障害が示唆された。Johnsenの平均スコアと精細管壁の肥厚は、臨床病期、赤沈値、血清β-hCG、AFP、LH、FSHのいずれとも関連しなかった。精細管壁の肥厚は腫瘍重量150g以上の患者10例中8例で認められたが、より軽い腫瘍の患者10例中1例でしか認められなかった（p<0.01）。
